script: Stop. Before CPI hits this week — can you even spot a real order block? Most funded traders fail this. Let's find out. Here's the question. Price sweeps a previous high, then drops into this zone. What is this called? Option A: Support zone. Option B: Bearish order block after liquidity sweep. Option C: Fair value gap. Think carefully. Bearish order block — formed after smart money swept buyside liquidity above that high. The lesson? Smart money always raids liquidity before reversing. No sweep — no valid order block.
